name: Niharika Ray Baral / ନିହାରିକା ରାୟ ବରାଳ

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Niharika Ray Baral is an Odia poet and translator. Alongside her Kabita Live contribution, her poetry appears in the Chandrasekharpur Sahitya Sansad’s Epatrika. Its July 2023 issue includes ‘ଆ’ ମିତ ବସିବା’, a poem that addresses sorrow as a companion with whom pain can be shared.

Her Kabita Live poem ‘ପାରୁଚ ତ ଆସ’ also takes the form of an invitation. Its repeated call moves from helplessness towards gestures of care: wiping away fear, offering shade and allowing the earth to rest. The intimacy of a lullaby and a gentle morning opens into a larger wish for renewal.
